dragon_species.dragonsurvival.wing_kirin:
§7■§6 Wing Kirin§7 is the Great Auspicious Beasts from ancient mythology, born above the Nine Heavens. Its body is covered in golden scales, it treads on auspicious clouds, its form flows with the wind, and its crane-like wings hang from the sky. It dwells among the clouds and rainbows, bathed in the Qi of the Grand Purity; it harnesses the harsh winds as its chariot, roaming beyond the Eight Extremities.

§2■ Features:§7 Attacks are powerful and forceful, abilities are divided into innate and acquired, the latter, although expensive, has a strong effect.
§4■ Curses: §7Difficulty entering the Nether, in dimensions outside the main world, it will fall into a weakened state.

§3■ Unlock Conditions: §7
1. Complete the§6 Beginner Tutorial§7.
